description: This file defines an object 'WakeWords' that manages a collection of wake words, including parsing, sanitation, and change detection functionality.

methods.name: parseCommaSeparated
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string into a list of trimmed, non-empty strings.

methods.name: parseIfChanged
methods.description: Checks if the parsed list of words from input differs from the current list, returning the new list if changed.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Cleans a list of words by trimming, filtering empty entries, limiting length and count, and defaulting if result is empty.
